title: Point-automorphism transport commutes with completed coefficient extension
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite coefficient fields $E\subset L\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and uniformizers [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and let $g:s\to s$ be any scheme automorphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $G_F=g^{-1}$ on completed $\mathcal O_F$-module complexes, with the coefficient action through $c_F^{-1}$, and $P_F=Lg_F^*$ for completed derived pullback [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], for $F=E,L$. For $K\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], put $T K=K\widehat\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Write $\sigma^{g,F}$ for the restriction/coprojection maps of [lem-weil-point-automorphism-restriction-natural].

For a constructible complex $H$ put $C H=H\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L$, where $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,s}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and let $\chi_H:C H\to T H$ be the specified completion comparison [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Let $b_K:C G_E K\to G_L C K$ be the canonical inverse-image tensor comparison and let $\beta_K=G_L(\chi_K)b_K\chi_{G_EK}^{-1}:T G_E K\to G_L T K$ be exactly the comparison of [lem-weil-isomorphism-comparison-scalar-extension]. Let $\varphi_H:\Gamma(s,T H)\to\Gamma(s,H)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$ be exactly the sections comparison of [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension], namely $\varphi_H=(\Gamma(s,\chi_H)\circ\theta_H)^{-1}$, where $\theta_H:\Gamma(s,H)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L\to\Gamma(s,CH)$ is the canonical sections-tensor map. All occurrences of $G_EK,P_EK$ here are constructible and derived complete [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback]. Put $\psi_K=\varphi_{G_EK}\Gamma(s,\beta_K)^{-1}$. Then
$$\psi_K\sigma^{g,L}_{TK}=(\sigma^{g,E}_K\otimes1)\varphi_K.$$

Let $\kappa^F_H:G_F H\to P_F H$ be the specified integral comparison [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] and define $t^F_H=\Gamma(s,\kappa^F_H)\sigma^{g,F}_H$. For the canonical $\alpha_K:T(P_EK)\to P_L(TK)$ [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], one has
$$\varphi_{P_EK}\Gamma(s,\alpha_K)^{-1}t^L_{TK}=(t^E_K\otimes1)\varphi_K.$$
After tensoring this equation with $L$, it gives the same compatibility for $t^{E,\mathrm{rat}}_K=t^E_K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$ on the raw rationalized categories [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], under the rational sections and pullback scalar comparisons. These equations are compatible with identity and successive finite coefficient extensions under the canonical associators of the two cited scalar-comparison lemmas. No naturality of $t^F$ in $H$ is asserted here.

proof.text: The finite field k_0 has characteristic p by its cardinality. Since l and p are distinct primes, l is nonzero and a unit in k_0; its images in k and every stalk are units. Restriction along the point automorphism is an isomorphism on section modules. Its naturality is the sectionwise-pinned restriction-natural theorem.

Use the explicit ordinary tensor models in the point-sections and isomorphism-scalar-comparison lemmas. Adjunction reduces equality of tensor maps to generators 1 tensor x. The canonical sections tensor map, the restriction map, and the inverse-image tensor map all send such a generator to the ordinary tensor section of the restricted x, by the restriction formula. Thus the ordinary restriction tensor square commutes. Descend this square along the exact derived functors using the functoriality of mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and the composition isomorphisms. Identify this descended square with the specified sections comparison via the unique cochain normalization of isomorphismScalarModel and pointOrdinaryDerivedComparison.

Write the inverse of phi as the exact ordinary tensor comparison followed by sections of chi. Naturality of restriction at chi, together with the preceding square and beta = chi_G inverse followed by b followed by G(chi), gives the inverse-image completed scalar square by cancellation. Use the specified kappa coefficient square and naturality of phi at kappa to obtain the pullback transport square. Constructibility and completeness of G K and P K supply precisely the existing comparison hypotheses.

For unit and tower coherence, use the naturality of the specified kappa from isomorphism-comparison-natural. The complete coefficient comparison system identifies its derived unit on a complete object as an isomorphism, so kappa, restriction, and their composite t are isomorphisms on the relevant objects. Apply naturality of restriction or t to the canonical scalar unit and associator. Paste the previously proved scalar squares with the unit and tower equations for phi, and cancel restriction or t at the extended object. This yields both integral coherence equations directly, without separate beta or alpha tower assertions.

Apply module rationalization to the integral scalar square and coherence equations. Naturality of the tensor-rationalization comparison and its unit and tower equations, all supplied by the point-sections scalar-extension API, give the rational scalar, unit, and tower equations under exactly the named rational comparisons.
